_meta.datasheet_section: Figure 1 (SOT23-5 Pin Assignments, Top View) + Table 2 (Pin Configuration)
_meta.notes: Pins 2 and 3 are listed in Table 2 as 'NC/GND, No Connect, Connect to GND or leave floating'. Type as 'reserved' so the validator allows either floating OR a GND tie — datasheet sanctions both modes. Typing 'nc' would forbid the GND tie our wakeup_board build uses.

pins.name: GND
pins.note: Table 2: 'Connect to ground. All GND pins must be connected to power supply ground.'

pins.name: NC/GND
pins.note: Table 2: 'Connect to GND or leave floating' — datasheet permits both.

pins.name: NC/GND
pins.note: Table 2: 'Connect to GND or leave floating' — datasheet permits both.

pins.name: VDD
pins.note: Table 2: 1.5 V ≤ Vdd ≤ 3.63 V. Internal filtering — no external bypass cap required.

pins.name: CLK Out
pins.note: Oscillator clock output, LVCMOS. 32.768 kHz nominal per the -DCC-32.768E order code; ±20 ppm initial tolerance, ±100 ppm over -40..+85 °C.
